QuestInfo.name: [Cash] Blair, Goddess of Chance
QuestInfo.0:
Every day is a lucky day with Blair, the Goddess of Chance!

#e#bCaution!
1) Blair's chance item can be purchased only once per Nexon ID. 
    (The item cannot be purchased even if the item was purchased today from a different account.) 
2) Item can only be purchased on the day Blair's chance is accepted.
